create_after_job_plan: create an AfterJobPlan to schedule downstream jobs after a processing step completes
run_after_job_plan: run an AfterJobPlan to create or delete waiting jobs based on the processing graph
finish_job: finish a job by caching the result and triggering dependent downstream jobs
check_pending_ancestor_jobs: check if any ancestor jobs are still pending for a given processing step
remove_dataset_jobs_and_cache: remove all pending jobs and cached responses for a dataset from the queue
